answered.sql: SELECT T1.movie_title FROM Movie_Elements AS T1 JOIN Composer AS T2 ON T1.composer_id = T2.id WHERE T2.creator = 'John Williams' AND (T1.element_type = 'Sound Design' OR T1.element_type = 'Music Score')

candidates.meaning: Find films where both sound design and music score are composed by John Williams.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.movie_title FROM Movie_Elements AS T1 JOIN Composer AS T2 ON T1.composer_id = T2.id WHERE T2.creator = 'John Williams' AND T1.element_type = 'Sound Design' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T1.movie_title FROM Movie_Elements AS T1 JOIN Composer AS T2 ON T1.composer_id = T2.id WHERE T2.creator = 'John Williams' AND T1.element_type = 'Music Score'

candidates.meaning: Films with both 'Sound Design' and 'Music Score' composed by John Williams.
candidates.sql: SELECT T1.title FROM Film AS T1 JOIN Movie_Elements AS T2 ON T1.title = T2.movie_title WHERE T2.composer_id = (SELECT id FROM Composer WHERE creator = 'John Williams') AND T2.element_type IN ('Sound Design', 'Music Score')
